runs.note: A recorded startup seed is used when present; otherwise the first observation seeds both estimators. Ragged history is row-weighted across every lane; width and GPU/ANE path have separate cells. Missing execution-path metadata is kept separate from known GPU/ANE paths. Prediction error is not measured latency or throughput benefit.
